title: ART-12D: Akashic Resonance Theory in 12 Dimensions - simulation code and corrected preprint (v31.0)
description:
Simulation package accompanying the ART-12D preprint, together with the corrected version 31 of the paper in Romanian, English, German, French, Spanish and Italian.

The code implements the relations of Part II of the paper: the Kaluza-Klein spectrum (equidistant, m_n = n/R), the tachyonic branch, the akashic field modes, the equation of state of an oscillating scalar field, the Yukawa coupling and its fifth-force bound, the consciousness field with an integrated-information proxy, an EEG hyperscanning model with a full statistical power analysis, and the word-field acoustic coupling.

It also produces a numerical audit of version 30 of the paper: 5 statements reproduce, 10 are inconsistent with their own definitions, and 2 cannot be tested as written. The audit is regenerated automatically in results/atr12_report.md.

Epistemic status: this is a speculative preprint. There is no experimental evidence for the theory. The code does not provide such evidence; it provides a reproducible model, concrete numerical predictions and a list of corrections.
notes: Languages: Romanian (full, 41 pages) and English, German, French, Spanish, Italian (condensed, 19 pages each). Version 30 of the paper is kept in the repository for comparison.
